sn22.123:4.1: Arahatā panāvuso Sāriputta katame dhammā yoniso manasi kattabbāti || || 17
sn22.123:4.2: Arahatā pi kho āvuso Koṭṭhita ime pañcupādānakkhande aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato yoniso manasi kattabbā || || 18
sn22.123:4.3: Natthi khvāvuso arahato uttarikaraṇīyaṃ katassa vā paṭiccayo ||
sn22.123:4.4: api ca kho ime dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārāya ceva saṃvattanti satisampajaññāya cāti || || 1
